text:
sara: Morning — quick async standup from product. TL;DR: roadmap pruning done for the week, need a quick CR + infra unblock.

sara: What I did: finished the SKU-mapping spec and synced with infra; uploaded the final doc to the drive.

sara: Blockers: dedicated test cluster is still in 'provisioning' (infra ticket #452). Can't run the end-to-end perf harness.

sara: Today: follow up on infra ticket, get a CR for the UI/UX copy updates, and prep rollout notes for the gates checklist.

josh: FYI I pushed a small fix to the mapping UI: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2894> — needs a quick review for aria roles and the table layout.

josh: I can pick up the CR later today, but would appreciate a second set of eyes from @liam on the accessibility bits.

liam: Will review PR #2894 in a bit. Quick heads up: I flagged a possible edge-case with long model names overflowing the layout — left an inline comment. :eyes:

liam: Re infra, I chatted with infra on the ticket. They said the cluster hit a quota on GPUs; they raised a request with cloud ops. ETA ~3 hrs.

emmam: For rollout notes — do we want to include the quantization toggle docs? PM asked to hold the toggle until canary. I recommend we include the note but mark it as "do not enable" by default.

sara: Agree — include the toggle as a section with the warning and canary steps. I'll add it to the doc after CRs merge.

josh: Quick question: is there an acceptance test that asserts no change in p99 latency for non-quantized path? If not, we should add one to the e2e harness.

liam: There's a smoke test but not p99 regressions. I can add a perf assertion to the harness — will create a small test in the infra/perf repo and link it here.

sara: Great — can you link the test PR here when you open it? We'll gate the rollout on that passing.

deploy-bot: deploy request queued for branch feature/sku-map. Status: waiting on perf-checks. (task id: db-7781)

josh: tagging @liam and @emmam on PRs now. Also pinging infra channel to expedite quota request.

liam: PR for perf assertion opened: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/perf-harness/pull/402> — added a p99 guard for base path. CI will run after infra cluster is provisioned.

emmam: Quick logistics: can we shift the canary window to 48h instead of 24h? Some customers want slightly longer to validate. If so we'll update the rollout doc.

sara: Let's keep default 24h but add optional steps to extend to 48h for enterprise canaries. Will note that.

josh: I'll reserve time tomorrow morning for any hotfixes post-rollout.

sara: Thanks all. Action items: sara — update rollout doc with toggle warning; josh — finish UI CR; liam — land perf assertion; emmam — update canary appendix; infra — finish quota (ticket #452). We reconvene async here after infra is green. :thumbsup:
